title: Find Bottom Left Tree Value
description:
You are given the root of a binary tree. 
 
 Return the leftmost value in the last row of the tree. 

 Example 1: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2020/12/14/tree1.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 root = [2,1,3]

Output:
 1

Explanation:
 The last row is [1,3], so the leftmost value is 1.
```

 Example 2: 
 [Figure: https://assets.leetcode.com/uploads/2020/12/14/tree2.jpg] 
 
```
Input:
 root = [1,2,3,4,null,5,6,null,null,7]

Output:
 7

Explanation:
 The last row contains only the node 7.
```

 Constraints: 

 The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [1, 10 4 ] . 
 
 -2 31 <= Node.val <= 2 31 - 1
